```{r}
Master <- Master |>
  filter(between(as.integer(substr(year_month, 1, 4)), 2013, 2022))
Master <- Master |>
  mutate(year = substr(year_month, 1, 4),
         month = substr(year_month, 6, 7))
Master <- Master |>
  relocate(year_month, year, month, .after = longitude)
```


# Combining by survey_id: MPA status, Population, MHW, and Bioregions

```{r}
combined <- Master |>
  left_join(mpa, by = 'survey_id')
combined <- combined |>
  left_join(rawpopulation, by = 'survey_id')
combined <- combined |>
  rename(population_50km = population)
combined <- combined |>
  relocate(iucn_protection_status, population_50km, .after = month)
combined <- combined |>
  left_join(bioregions, by = "survey_id")
combined <- combined |>
  relocate(population_50km, bioregion, .after = month)
```

```{r}
combined <- combined |>
  mutate(protection = case_when(
    iucn_protection_status == "unprotected" ~ "take",
    iucn_protection_status != "unprotected" ~ "no take"
  ))

combined <- combined |>
  relocate(protection, .after = iucn_protection_status)
```

```{r}
heatwave <- heatwave |>
  dplyr::select(survey_id, total_mhw_intensity, mhw_days, n_mhw_events, n_5day_mhw_events, peak_intensity_sum)
combined <- combined |>
  left_join(heatwave, by = "survey_id")
combined <- combined |>
  relocate(total_mhw_intensity, mhw_days, n_mhw_events, n_5day_mhw_events, peak_intensity_sum, .after = protection)
```

# Taking Monthly Average

```{r}
combined <- combined |>
  group_by(latitude, longitude, year_month) |>
  summarise(across(where(is.numeric) & !c(survey_id, year, population_50km, year, month, ), 
                   \(x) mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)),
            population_50km = first(population_50km),
            year = first(year),
            month = first(month),
            survey_id = first(survey_id),
            site_name = first(site_name),
            location = first(location),
            iucn_protection_status = first(iucn_protection_status),
            mpa_name = first(mpa_name),
            mpa_type = first(mpa_type),
            protection = first(protection),
            total_mhw_intensity = mean(total_mhw_intensity),
            n_mhw_events = mean(n_mhw_events),
            mhw_days = mean(mhw_days),
            depth = mean(depth),
            bioregion = first(bioregion),
            n_5day_mhw_events = mean(n_5day_mhw_events),
            peak_intensity_sum = mean(peak_intensity_sum),
            .groups = "drop")

combined <- combined |>
  relocate(survey_id, site_name, location, .before = latitude)

combined <- combined |>
  relocate(year, month, .after = year_month)

combined <- combined |>
  relocate(population_50km, iucn_protection_status, .after = month)

combined <- combined |>
  relocate(protection, .after = iucn_protection_status)

combined <- combined |>
  relocate(total_mhw_intensity, n_mhw_events, mhw_days, n_5day_mhw_events, peak_intensity_sum, .after = protection)
```


# Combining After Average: Temperature, Chloro, Fishing, Shipping
## Temperature

```{r}
#fixing character sea surface temperature columns for NA removal
rawtemp$sea_surface_temperature <- as.numeric(rawtemp$sea_surface_temperature)
rawtemp$sea_surface_temperature_anomaly <- as.numeric(rawtemp$sea_surface_temperature_anomaly)
#removing NA values
cleantemp <- rawtemp[complete.cases(rawtemp[ , c('sea_surface_temperature', 'sea_surface_temperature_anomaly')]), ]
#creating a month year column
cleantemp$time <- as.POSIXct(cleantemp$time, format = "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ", tz = "UTC")
cleantemp$year_month <- format(cleantemp$time, "%Y_%m")
#renaming lat and lon for next step
cleantemp <- cleantemp |>
  rename(temp_lat = latitude,
         temp_lon = longitude)
```

```{r}
combined <- combined |>
  group_by(year_month) |>
  group_modify(~ {
    # filter predictor to same time period
    pred_subset <- cleantemp |> 
      filter(year_month == .y$year_month) #.y is the set of grouping variable values (in this case, values from the combined dataset)
    
    # find nearest neighbor
    nn <- nn2(
      data = pred_subset[, c("temp_lon", "temp_lat")],
      query = .x[, c("longitude", "latitude")], #.x represents the grouping dataset
      k = 1
    )
    
    # add matched temperature value
    .x$sea_surface_temperature <- pred_subset$sea_surface_temperature[nn$nn.idx]
    .x$sea_surface_temperature_anomaly <- pred_subset$sea_surface_temperature_anomaly[nn$nn.idx]
    .x
  }) |>
  ungroup()

combined <- combined |>
  relocate(sea_surface_temperature, sea_surface_temperature_anomaly, .after = iucn_protection_status)
```

## Chlorophyll
```{r}
#fixing character sea surface temperature columns for NA removal
rawchlorophyll$chlor_a <- as.numeric(rawchlorophyll$chlor_a)
rawchlorophyll$longitude <- as.numeric(rawchlorophyll$longitude)
rawchlorophyll$latitude <- as.numeric(rawchlorophyll$latitude)
#removing NA values
cleanchloro <- rawchlorophyll[complete.cases(rawchlorophyll[ , c('chlor_a')]), ]
#creating a month year column
cleanchloro$time <- as.POSIXct(cleanchloro$time, format = "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ", tz = "UTC")
cleanchloro$year_month <- format(cleanchloro$time, "%Y_%m")
#renaming lat and lon for next step
cleanchloro <- cleanchloro |>
  rename(chloro_lat = latitude,
         chloro_lon = longitude)
```

```{r}
combined <- combined |>
  group_by(year_month) |>
  group_modify(~ {
    pred_subset <- cleanchloro |> 
      filter(year_month == .y$year_month)
    
    # handle missing year_month
    if(nrow(pred_subset) == 0) {
      .x$chlor_a <- NA
      return(.x)
    }
    
    nn <- nn2(
      data = pred_subset[, c("chloro_lon", "chloro_lat")],
      query = .x[, c("longitude", "latitude")],
      k = 1
    )
    
    .x$chlor_a <- as.numeric(pred_subset$chlor_a)[as.vector(nn$nn.idx)]
    .x
  }) |>
  ungroup()

combined <- combined |>
  relocate(chlor_a, .after = sea_surface_temperature_anomaly)
```

## Fishing

```{r}
fishing <- fishing |>
  rename(fish_lat = latitude,
         fish_lon = longitude,
         apparent_fishing_hours = Apparent_Fishing_Hours)
```

```{r}
distance_threshold <- 0.1

combined <- combined |>
  group_by(year_month) |>
  group_modify(~ {
    pred_subset <- fishing |> 
      filter(year_month == .y$year_month)
    
    if(nrow(pred_subset) == 0) {
      .x$apparent_fishing_hours <- 0
      return(.x)
    }
    
    nn <- nn2(
      data = pred_subset[, c("fish_lon", "fish_lat")],
      query = .x[, c("longitude", "latitude")],
      k = 1
    )
    
    .x$apparent_fishing_hours <- as.numeric(ifelse(
      nn$nn.dists <= distance_threshold,
      as.numeric(pred_subset$apparent_fishing_hours)[as.vector(nn$nn.idx)],
      0
    ))
    .x
  }) |>
  ungroup()

combined <- combined |>
  relocate(apparent_fishing_hours, .after = chlor_a)
```

## Shipping

```{r}
ship <- ship |>
  rename(ship_lat = latitude,
         ship_lon = longitude)
```

```{r}
distance_threshold <- 0.1

combined <- combined |>
  group_by(year_month) |>
  group_modify(~ {
    pred_subset <- ship |> 
      filter(year_month == .y$year_month)
    
    if(nrow(pred_subset) == 0) {
      .x$ship_count <- 0
      return(.x)
    }
    
    nn <- nn2(
      data = pred_subset[, c("ship_lon", "ship_lat")],
      query = .x[, c("longitude", "latitude")],
      k = 1
    )
    
    .x$ship_count <- as.numeric(ifelse(
      nn$nn.dists <= distance_threshold,
      as.numeric(pred_subset$ship_count)[as.vector(nn$nn.idx)],
      0
    ))
    .x
  }) |>
  ungroup()

combined <- combined |>
  relocate(ship_count, .after = apparent_fishing_hours)
```

## Currents

```{r}
currents <- currents |>

         current_lon = longitude,
         current_intensity_score = intensity_score)
```


```{r}
combined <- combined |>
  group_by(year_month) |>
  group_modify(~ {
    # filter predictor to same time period
    pred_subset <- currents |> 
      filter(year_month == .y$year_month) #.y is the set of grouping variable values (in this case, values from the combined dataset)
    
    # find nearest neighbor
    nn <- nn2(
      data = pred_subset[, c("current_lon", "current_lat")],
      query = .x[, c("longitude", "latitude")], #.x represents the grouping dataset
      k = 1
    )
    
    # add matched temperature value
    .x$current_intensity_score <- pred_subset$current_intensity_score[nn$nn.idx]
    .x
  }) |>
  ungroup()

combined <- combined |>
  relocate(current_intensity_score, .after = ship_count)
```

# Adding Special Calculation columns

```{r}
combined <- combined |>
  mutate(log_population = log(population_50km))

combined$year <- as.numeric(combined$year)

combined <- combined |>
  mutate(years_since_start = year - 2005)

combined <- combined |>
  relocate(log_population, .after = population_50km)

combined <- combined |>
  relocate(years_since_start, .after = year)

combined <- combined |>
  relocate(bioregion, .after = location)
```

## Fixing Yallock-Bulluk points
```{r}
combined |>
  filter(grepl("Yallock", mpa_name)) |>
  dplyr::select(mpa_name, protection, mpa_type) |>
  distinct()
```

```{r}
combined <- combined |>
  mutate(
    protection = ifelse(grepl("Yallock-Bulluk", mpa_name), "take", protection),
    mpa_type = ifelse(grepl("Yallock-Bulluk", mpa_name), NA, mpa_type),
    mpa_name = ifelse(grepl("Yallock-Bulluk", mpa_name), NA, mpa_name)
  )
```

```{r}
unique(combined$mpa_name)
```
